texts.text:
You are invited to take part in research evaluating the iSupport-D digital support program for carers of people living with dementia.
Participation may involve:
Completing questionnaires or feedback activities
Allowing analysis of how you use the platform
Contributing information about caregiving experiences and wellbeing
Some questions may relate to health or other sensitive personal information.
Your participation is voluntary.
Before agreeing, please understand that:
You may decline to answer any question.
You may withdraw from research participation at any time without penalty.
Withdrawal will not affect access to general educational program content unless required by the research protocol.
Information collected may be analysed in de-identified or aggregated form and used in research publications or reports.
Identifiable data will be handled securely in accordance with privacy laws and ethics approval.
Your data may be stored or analysed by authorised research partners, including those located outside Australia.
The platform uses digital analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve program delivery. These tools do not provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice.
If you have concerns about the conduct of this research, you may contact the approving Human Research Ethics Committee.
For questions regarding these Terms, please contact:
